ratios.facility: Credit Agreement (amended and restated, Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, as administrative agent)
ratios.quote: At June 30, 2026, our consolidated total leverage ratio under the Credit Agreement was 2.91 to 1.00 as compared to a covenant maximum of 5.25 to 1.00.

ratios.facility: Credit Agreement (amended and restated, Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, as administrative agent)
ratios.quote: At June 30, 2026, our consolidated interest coverage ratio under the Credit Agreement was 3.27 to 1.00 as compared to a covenant minimum of 2.75 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: The Third Amendment (Feb 25, 2026) set the maximum leverage at 5.25x for Q1-Q2 2026, stepping down to 5.00x in Q3 2026, 4.00x in Q4 2026 and 3.50x for 2027 and thereafter. The minimum interest coverage of 2.75x applies through Q4 2026. The company reports compliance at December 31, 2025, but the excerpt gives no ratio values for that date. The SOFR margin of 1.25%-3.25% is based on leverage pricing tiers, not a covenant, so it is excluded.
